responsibility: Defines regression and stress tests for the vec_cache module, validating VecCache lookup and insertion behavior, sparse bucket-backed growth across large key ranges, concurrent completion safety, and the correctness of the slot-to-bucket indexing tables that partition u32 keys.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `tests.rs` files, this one stresses a sparse, bucketed concurrent cache representation, including exhaustive slot-index partitioning and multi-threaded completion behavior, rather than higher-level map transactions or graph algorithms.
